What Ooak Data sells

Turns real business work into AI practice tasks while removing identifying details from the data.

  • Enterprise digital twins · Removes identifying details from connected company communications, documents and tools. Preserves their relationships and the company’s structure.
  • RL environments · Tasks with several steps, based on real company work and calibrated against advanced models.
  • Company data licensing · Acquires connected business datasets. Handles extraction and delivery while removing identifying details across sources.
  • Data Hub · Instructions for connecting and exporting company data. Named in the official first product-manager job description.
